body: I stand there, my face flushed with anger as I watch the stranger make their escape back up the mountain. Anger flares within me like wildfire, but every step backwards feels heavier than before. The trees blur into a muddled haze as panic starts to take hold, threatening to engulf me whole. My heart races faster with each breath I take, pounding in my chest like a drum. But something inside me holds on, refusing to be completely consumed by fear. I know that confronting this person will only end in more pain or worse outcomes, so instead of giving them an opening to hurt again, I start walking slowly down the trail, trying to gather some strength for when they come next. If they dare to come closer, I'll do everything in my power not to fall apart under their gaze.
